payload.protocol: Common union of original groups and identical rounded imputed vectors in either aggregation; grouped outer5/inner3; inner mean AUC selects 20-candidate hyperparameters; threshold minimizes inner-OOF sens/spec gap, MCC tie-break; 606 original rows evaluated; 67 augmentation rows train-only, blocked by both held-out partitions; all learned preprocessing inside training folds.
payload.scope: A uses no additional concentration block; B uses four fold-imputed concentration features for ALL three models and BOTH aggregations. Not a concentration-ablation or independent external validation.
payload.cache_reuse: No historical model predictions reused because max representation merges additional groups.
payload.selection_rule: Within each label, compare mean overall OOF MCC, sensitivity/specificity, seedwise paired effects, and multi-component subgroup. Three seeds are descriptive and not independent-cohort confidence intervals.
